key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:2826
name: return_zero_stub
description: Returns zero without doing any other work. It is a stub entry whose only result is the success value.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:2884
name: clear_request_slot_status
description: Takes a pointer from a library call and returns minus one when it is null. Otherwise it clears the 16-bit status word at that pointer and returns zero, or minus one when a global word is set and the entry's flag bit is clear.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:28E8
name: service_signal_callback
description: Reads the task signal state through the exec SetSignal call and, when the upper signal bits are set and a registered callback exists, runs the callback. If the callback reports success it clears the callback slot and runs a follow-up routine.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:1:2926
name: forward_to_routine
description: Passes control straight to one other routine and returns. It adds no work of its own.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0000
name: setup_audio_channel_buffers
description: Allocates a memory block and divides it into four channel structures and two shared buffers, copying a 16-long-word template into each. It then opens the audio device and sets the channel fields before returning.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0172
name: dispatch_audio_command
description: Selects an action from a command number from zero to three. Each case calls library routines, and command three spins until a flag is cleared. The default case clears a pending flag and runs a follow-up routine.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:01FE
name: queue_channel_io_request
description: Fills a channel's request block with the supplied values, length and priority fields. It swaps the active and pending request pointers for that channel and sends the block through the device begin-I/O call.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:030A
name: submit_channel_request
description: Stores a request value in the channel's request block and zeroes the second value when a mute flag is set. It then sends the block through the device begin-I/O call.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0354
name: flush_pending_channel_requests
description: Checks four channel flags. For each channel with a pending request it stores the saved value in the shared request block, sends it through begin-I/O, and clears the flag.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:03B2
name: finish_channel_request_countdown
description: For a channel with a pending request, clears its status field and sends the saved value through begin-I/O. It then clears the pending flag and sets that channel's countdown to one hundred.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0420
name: read_combined_record_value
description: Opens a file and reads two values through the file routines, then combines them into one result. The first value is divided by ten and scaled by one hundred before the second is added, and a failure message names the file when it cannot be opened.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:04D4
name: allocate_memory_or_fail
description: Requests a memory block through the exec AllocMem call and reports failure through a routine when the result is zero. It returns the allocated pointer, or zero.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0500
name: open_read_close_file
description: Opens a named file, reads its contents with the DOS read call, then closes it. When the open fails it reports the file name in an error message and returns zero.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:054E
name: start_playback_once
description: Sets a playing flag the first time it runs and, on that first run, sets a second flag and calls a routine. Later calls do nothing.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0576
name: activate_channel_slot
description: Clears the level and sequence fields of a channel slot and marks the slot active. When the second argument is nonzero it runs an additional routine.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:05AA
name: update_channel_state_if_matching
description: When the slot's stored identifier equals the given value and the slot is active, it writes the new state value into that slot.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:05EC
name: set_channel_note_and_volume
description: Looks up a value in a twelve-entry table using the note index modulo twelve and stores it in the channel. It also doubles the stored value once per octave step and writes the channel's volume when the note changes.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0664
name: refresh_channel_volume_state
description: Reads a table entry for the channel's sample, stores the channel's pointer and length, and recomputes the channel volume when the sample assignment has changed. It then runs a routine to apply the new value.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0776
name: set_channel_volume_and_pointer
description: Writes a level value into the channel, clears its counters, and recomputes its volume from a table when the sample assignment has changed. It then runs a routine to apply the result.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:08A8
name: parse_string_table_entries
description: Opens a text data resource through the file routines, then walks a sequence of null-terminated entries and records where each entry and each separated subfield begins. It reports the file name in an error message when the open fails.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0952
name: execute_track_command
description: Executes one track-stream command selected by a command code. Depending on the code it advances the channel's read pointer, stores a byte in a channel field, adjusts a shared total, updates a repeat counter, or jumps to a saved label.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:09B4
name: add_thousands_from_track_byte
description: Reads one byte from the channel's track stream, multiplies it by one thousand and adds it to a shared 16-bit total. It then advances the stream pointer.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:09E0
name: subtract_thousands_from_track_byte
description: Reads one byte from the channel's track stream, multiplies it by one thousand and subtracts it from a shared 16-bit total. It then advances the stream pointer.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0A0C
name: store_track_label_pointer
description: Reads a label index byte from the track stream and saves the current stream position in the channel's label table at that index. It then advances the stream pointer.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0A46
name: repeat_track_section_by_nibble
description: Reads a byte whose low four bits select a repeat counter for the channel. A positive counter is decremented and the stream jumps to the saved label for that index, while an idle counter is set to the sentinel and the command is stepped past.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0AA4
name: set_repeat_count_and_jump
description: When the channel's repeat counter is idle it sets the counter to the sentinel and steps past the byte. Otherwise it loads the counter from the high nibble of the track byte, minus one, and jumps the stream to the saved label.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0AEE
name: clear_track_slot_word
description: Writes the sentinel value minus one into a per-channel table slot and advances the channel's stream pointer by one byte.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0B12
name: jump_to_label_if_enabled
description: When a shared flag is clear, reads an index byte and sets the channel's stream pointer to the saved label at that index. When the flag is set it only steps past the byte.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0B2A
name: jump_to_track_label
description: Reads an index byte from the track stream and sets the channel's stream pointer to the saved label address for that index.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0B5C
name: branch_to_saved_label
description: Sets the channel's stream pointer to the saved label address selected by an index byte, using the same lookup as the plain label jump.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0B8E
name: store_byte_in_channel_field
description: Reads one byte from the track stream, advances the stream pointer, and stores the byte as a 16-bit value in this channel's field.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0BBA
name: add_byte_to_first_sum
description: Reads one byte from the track stream, advances the pointer, and adds the byte to the first shared 16-bit total.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0BDC
name: subtract_byte_from_first_sum
description: Reads one byte from the track stream, advances the pointer, and subtracts the byte from the first shared 16-bit total.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0BFE
name: add_byte_to_second_sum
description: Reads one byte from the track stream, advances the pointer, and adds the byte to the second shared 16-bit total.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0C20
name: subtract_byte_from_second_sum
description: Reads one byte from the track stream, advances the pointer, and subtracts the byte from the second shared 16-bit total.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0C40
name: add_byte_to_channel_total
description: Reads one byte from the track stream, advances the pointer, and adds the byte to this channel's 16-bit total.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0C6A
name: subtract_byte_from_channel_total
description: Reads one byte from the track stream, advances the pointer, and subtracts the byte from this channel's 16-bit total.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0C94
name: clear_track_continue_flag
description: Clears a shared flag word that the channel loop tests to decide whether to keep processing the current channel.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0C9A
name: advance_track_stream_by_one
description: Advances one channel's 32-bit track stream pointer by a single byte.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0CAE
name: run_track_channels_step
description: Steps through the four music channels once. For each channel whose wait counter has expired it reads track bytes: values below one hundred start a note, and larger values go to the command dispatcher until the shared continue flag is cleared.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0CDC
name: run_track_channel_from_index
description: Processes the track streams starting at a given channel index, reading bytes until the shared continue flag clears. Values below one hundred start a note on the channel, while larger values go to the command dispatcher and other channels' waits are counted down.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0D9A
name: advance_track_channels_with_waits
description: Walks the four channel slots, decrementing each wait counter and reading the next track byte for a channel once its wait has expired. Note values below one hundred start the note and set its duration, and larger values are passed to the command handler.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0DB6
name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without doing any work. It is an empty entry point.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0DBE
name: step_channel_volume_envelope
description: Moves a channel's volume toward a target computed from a per-channel lookup table. When the volume reaches zero on an active channel it sends the channel's request block and resets its countdown to one hundred.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0E52
name: set_channel_volume_and_advance
description: Writes a level value into a channel and advances its step counter. When the level reaches zero on an active channel it sends the channel's request block and resets its countdown to one hundred.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0E72
name: ramp_channel_volume_down
description: Lowers a channel's volume by a step, or sets it to the floor value when the step would pass it. It advances the step counter when the table value changes and handles a zero volume the same way as the other envelope steps.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0E98
name: set_volume_and_track_change
description: Writes a level value into a channel and advances its step counter when the next table entry differs from the previous one. It then runs the zero-volume check.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0EDC
name: set_channel_volume_and_finish
description: Writes a level value into a channel and runs the zero-volume check. A channel at zero volume that is still active sends its request block and has its countdown reset to one hundred.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:0F8E
name: step_channel_volume_toward_target
description: Moves a channel's volume one step toward a target from a lookup table and advances its step counter when the target is reached. A zero volume on an active channel sends the request block and resets the countdown.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:1014
name: advance_channel_step_and_check
description: Advances a channel's step counter and runs the zero-volume check. A channel at zero volume triggers its follow-up request and countdown reset.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:1028
name: lower_channel_volume_stepwise
description: Lowers a channel's volume by one when it is above the target, otherwise advances its step counter if the next table entry changed. It then runs the zero-volume check.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:104C
name: advance_channel_step_on_change
description: Advances a channel's step counter when its next table entry differs from the current one, then runs the zero-volume check.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:111E
name: tick_track_envelopes
description: Runs once per timer tick. It counts down a shared tick divider and, for each of the four channels, steps the envelope through a table of levels and applies the new levels. A shared pending flag is set while any channel is still active.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:113C
name: update_all_track_envelopes
description: Advances a shared tick counter and, for each of the four channels, steps the envelope through its level table and applies the result. The active flag is cleared only when no channel remains running and the continue flag is clear.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:121A
name: step_remaining_track_envelopes
description: Continues the envelope update across the channels after the current one, computing each level from the lookup table and applying it. It sets the active flag when a channel is still running.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:128C
name: continue_envelope_update_loop
description: Runs the envelope update loop over the channels that follow the current one, applying table levels and stepping their counters. It sets the active flag when any channel is still running.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:129C
name: decrement_channel_wait_and_continue
description: Decrements a channel's countdown, then steps through the following channels and applies table levels to any channel whose countdown has ended. It sets the active flag when any channel is still running.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:12B4
name: update_track_active_flag
description: Sets the shared active flag when the continue word or a channel countdown is still nonzero, and runs a follow-up routine in that case. It clears the flag when both are zero.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:12D2
name: clear_track_active_flag
description: Clears the shared active flag so that the track update reports no channel is running.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:12E0
name: start_sequence_if_idle
description: When a shared busy word is zero, it calls a routine and then starts a follow-up call with a stored argument and a pointer into the audio data area. It does nothing when the busy word is set.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:12E6
name: allocate_list_record
description: Searches a linked list for an unused record and, when none is free, allocates and zeroes a new one. It links the new record into the list and passes the record to a follow-up routine.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:12EC
name: store_high_bytes_of_argument
description: Writes the two upper bytes of its 32-bit argument into a shared global location.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:12F2
name: copy_stream_bytes_until_terminator
description: Copies bytes from a buffered input stream into an output buffer until a terminating 16-bit marker is seen or the requested count is reached. It refills the input buffer through a routine when it runs empty.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:12F8
name: format_text_into_buffer
description: Copies a format string into an output buffer and expands percent escapes by looking the following letter up in a conversion table. Each escape calls the matching routine, and the result is the number of characters written.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:1304
name: allocate_and_register_callback
description: Allocates a structure through a library call and, when that succeeds, fills it with a pair of configuration bytes and a callback pointer before registering it. It cleans up and returns a failure value when the registration returns zero.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:7:130A
name: finish_request_record
description: Finishes a request record by collecting its pending value when a flag bit is set and running a cleanup routine when the flag bits are clear. It then clears the status word and returns zero for success or minus one otherwise.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:2:0000
name: print_intuition_text_at
description: Positions an Intuition text block, measures its length with the library call, and prints it through the print call. When the first argument is minus one it reuses the last stored position.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:2:006E
name: drain_matching_port_messages
description: Takes messages from a message port and replies to each one whose flag word matches the given mask. It then resets two status words so the caller sees the port as idle.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:2:00CC
name: test_point_inside_rectangle
description: Returns one when the given horizontal and vertical coordinates lie within the four bounds stored at the target address, and zero otherwise.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:2:0104
name: build_colour_register_table
description: Walks a copper-style colour list and records where each colour register's value words begin, so that later code can update those registers. It fills the upper entries from the remaining records.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:2:01D6
name: load_palette_colours
description: Loads a colour table through the graphics library call, then copies colour words from a stored table into the colour-register pointers from index thirty-two up to the given limit.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:2:0232
name: read_joystick_fire_button
description: Drains pending input messages, then reads the fire-button bit from the CIA port register and returns a button code. It returns a fixed press code on the first press and a sentinel value when nothing has changed.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:2:0310
name: fade_palette_range
description: Brightens or darkens a range of palette entries by a per-channel step. It clamps each red, green and blue component at its limit, then applies the result through a follow-up routine.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:2:0448
name: copy_palette_and_wait_frames
description: Copies a range of colour words from a stored palette into the working colour table. It then runs sixteen steps, each of which calls a routine and waits for the display frame twice.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:2:04BA
name: copy_palette_in_steps
description: Copies a range of colour words into the working colour table over ten steps, waiting for the display frame between steps.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:5:0000
name: check_picture_index_zero
description: Checks that a picture index argument is zero and reports an error through a routine when it is not. The condition and source file text in the executable mark it as a debugging check.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:5:0102
name: build_picture_row_pointers
description: Computes bytes per row from the picture width and fills a row-pointer table with each bitplane's start address. It then reads the picture's data block through a follow-up routine.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:5:0198
name: open_picture_file_header
description: Opens the picture file, checks the requested picture index against the library's picture count, and reads the file header. It verifies the expected header and record sizes, reports a fault when a check fails, and returns the computed data size.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:5:02BA
name: read_picture_offset_table
description: Seeks to the picture offset table, reads a range of records, and fills an offset table with cumulative sums of the stored sizes. It verifies the seek positions and returns the total size.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:5:03D8
name: close_picture_file
description: Closes the open picture file through the DOS close call when a file handle is held, then clears the stored handle.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:5:075C
name: forward_single_call
description: Contains one call that passes control to another routine. The decompiled body is unavailable, so only that call relationship is known.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:8:009E
name: open_cia_and_add_interrupt
description: Opens the CIA-A hardware resource by name and reports failure when it is missing. It sets up an interrupt structure with a callback pointer, registers it through the interrupt-vector add call, and returns one when that result is zero.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:8:0114
name: tick_track_envelopes
description: Runs once per timer tick. It counts down a shared tick divider and, for each of the four channels, steps the envelope through a table of levels and applies the new levels. A shared pending flag is set while any channel is still active.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:10:0000
name: run_colour_adjust_loop
description: Runs an input loop for a colour-setting screen. It reads window messages, changes palette entries with the RGB calls according to the input, and checks the elapsed time with the current-time call before returning.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:10:03E8
name: show_colour_wheel_instructions
description: Draws a colour-matching screen. It loads a colour table, sets the pen colours, clears the pointer and shows instruction text about lining up the inner and outer wheel with the colour in the box, using ten routine calls.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:10:05EC
name: clear_display_raster
description: Clears the graphics raster by calling the library SetRast routine with the stored arguments.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:10:05F2
name: build_picture_row_pointers
description: Computes bytes per row from the picture width and fills a row-pointer table with each bitplane's start address. It then reads the picture's data block through a follow-up routine.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:10:05F8
name: set_up_display_bitmaps
description: Initialises three display bitmap structures through the graphics InitBitMap call and points each one at its plane data. It then sets up three display areas by passing each one's position, size and depth settings to a routine.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:10:05FE
name: set_random_seed_word
description: Stores its 16-bit argument as the current value of a shared word used by the pseudo-random generator.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:10:0604
name: blit_bitmap_to_rastport
description: Calls the graphics bit-block copy routine that copies into a rastport, with the arguments already on the stack.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:10:060A
name: print_intuition_text_at
description: Positions an Intuition text block, measures its length with the library call, and prints it through the print call. When the first argument is minus one it reuses the last stored position.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:10:0610
name: drain_matching_port_messages
description: Takes messages from a message port and replies to each one whose flag word matches the given mask. It then resets two status words so the caller sees the port as idle.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:10:0616
name: reset_word_and_call_stack
description: Resets a shared word, calls a routine that writes into a stack variable, clears the byte the caller supplied and returns the shared word.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:10:061C
name: advance_random_seed
description: Advances a shared 15-bit pseudo-random value with a multiply-and-add step, masking the result to 15 bits.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:10:0622
name: check_fixed_load_result
description: Calls a routine with a fixed argument and, when the result is non-negative, runs two follow-up routines. It returns true when the result is non-negative.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:10:0628
name: forward_to_routine_once
description: Passes control to one other routine and returns with no other work.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:10:062E
name: test_point_inside_rectangle
description: Returns one when the given horizontal and vertical coordinates lie within the four bounds stored at the target address, and zero otherwise.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:10:0634
name: open_picture_file_header
description: Opens the picture file, checks the requested picture index against the library's picture count, and reads the file header. It verifies the expected header and record sizes, reports a fault when a check fails, and returns the computed data size.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:11:0188
name: call_library_entry_from_record
description: Calls the function at offset minus thirty of a library base held in its argument structure. The decompiled code has no other logic.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:6:0000
name: record_unrecovered_routine_body
description: The decompiler timed out, so the body is unavailable. The routine runs in the reference run and is called by one other routine, and no library, register or text use is recorded for it.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:tunnels:12:0000
name: forward_begin_io_request
description: Passes an I/O request to the device's begin-I/O entry, which is the device-base function at offset minus thirty stored in the request.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:loadwb:0:0000
name: run_program_entry_point
description: Program entry point. It allocates a startup structure, finds the current task, collects the startup message, opens the DOS library and the NIL: device, and changes to the current directory. An alert call reports the failure path.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:loadwb:0:01A0
name: release_saved_resources
description: Looks up the current task's saved resource block, stores the argument in it, and releases the resources it holds: a file handle, a library and a memory block, each only when it is set. It replies to a message as part of the release.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:loadwb:2:0000
name: start_workbench_tool
description: Opens the Workbench and icon libraries and checks an optional debug argument. It starts a tool whose resident tag is looked up by name, and it reports an error when the tag is missing or the tool cannot start.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:loadwb:2:0218
name: compare_strings
description: Compares two null-terminated strings byte by byte. It returns minus one when the first differing byte is smaller in the first string, one when it is larger, and zero when the strings are equal.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:loadwb:2:023E
name: build_linked_list_from_table
description: Allocates a small node for each table entry, stores a value from that entry in the node, and links the nodes in order. It returns the first node, or zero when an allocation fails.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:loadwb:10:0034
name: allocate_memory_block
description: Forwards its arguments to the exec allocation call and returns its result without any check.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:loadwb:4:0000
name: check_workbench_version_string
description: Checks a version text buffer against a stored release string. When the release character matches, it writes a fixed dot and spaces at the end of the text.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:loadwb:4:0028
name: write_dot_and_spaces_padding
description: Writes a period followed by four spaces into a five-byte field at a fixed offset in the target buffer.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:loadwb:4:0048
name: compare_prefix_with_stored_string
description: Compares a buffer with a stored string up to the stored string's terminating zero, then returns.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:loadwb:4:0058
name: return_without_action
description: Returns immediately without doing any work. It is an empty entry point.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:loadwb:6:0000
name: forward_with_stack_slot
description: Passes its two arguments and a pointer to a stack slot on to one routine, then returns.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:loadwb:5:0000
name: format_message_and_emit
description: Formats a message into a 140-byte stack buffer through the exec raw formatting call, measures the text length, and passes the text and length to a routine when the text is not empty.

key: tunnels of armageddon (1989)(california dreams)[cr pna]/Tunnels of Armageddon (1989)(California Dreams)[cr PNA].adf:loadwb:5:004C
name: store_byte_through_pointer
description: Stores the low byte of the data register at the address held in the pointer register.

name: start_copper_display_setup
description: Opens the graphics and exec libraries around a setup step. It writes the custom chip DMA-control register and the copper-list pointer and jump registers, and copies a colour list into the copper area.

name: service_interrupt_request_flag
description: When a shared interrupt bit is set, it runs two routines and clears the top bit of the shared word. It acknowledges the request in the interrupt request register.

key: runtime segment $050000-$050380:0:014A
name: step_sequence_word_from_table
description: Reads the next byte from a table pointer, wrapping to a fixed start address when a negative marker is reached. It combines the byte with a constant into a 16-bit value and advances the table pointer by four.

name: compute_scaled_display_values
description: Computes several display values from shared table entries, including a division by a shared scale factor, sign-dependent offsets and adjustments, and stores the results in shared fields.

name: reset_display_state_fields
description: Waits until a shared busy bit clears, then writes starting values into a group of shared fields and copies values from an input table.
